title: The Cold Pod XL Ice Bath Tub for Athletes (Cold Plunge)

comparisons.notes: The Cold Pod XL, 116 gal, 35.43in diameter, includes cover, legs, pump, drain hose and carry bag; page shows Immediate Dispatch and Add to cart at $159.99.

writeup: The Cold Pod XL ice bath tub is $49.99 new on Woot. It's a portable cold plunge that holds 116 gallons, roomy enough for taller athletes, and comes with a cover, legs, pump, drain hose and carry bag. The Cold Pod's own site sells the XL for $159.99. Woot showed just 1 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
